titles.name: DREAM VINE
titles.tagline: An original block-building sandbox. Explore endless worlds, mine, craft, build and survive the night.
titles.description: DREAM VINE is an original block-building sandbox game by EX Inc. Explore endless procedurally generated worlds, mine, craft and build, survive the night, or fly around freely in Creative. All code, textures, names, mobs and logos are original, and everything is generated procedurally.
features: Infinite chunked worlds from a seed: beaches, water, hills and mountains, forests, caves, ores and bedrock
Survival (health, hunger, fall damage, tool tiers) and Creative (all blocks, instant break, flying)
9-slot hotbar, 27-slot inventory and crafting: tools from wood to diamond, glass, bricks, Dream Vine blocks
Day/night cycle with sunsets, sun, moon, clouds and fog
Mobs: Mossbuck (passive grazer) and Gloomer (hostile at night, glowing eyes)
Text chat with commands: /gamemode, /time, /tp, /seed, /build, /undo and more
VINE BUILD (Creative): describe any building and Vine AI builds it in front of you, fully offline

titles.name: PIKNOTT CELESTIKA
titles.tagline: A fully cel-shaded monster-catching RPG. Catch 13 PIKNOTT across the Celestika region.
titles.description: Explore the Celestika region as a boy in a red hoodie, sneak through tall grass, throw PIKCEL balls to catch wild PIKNOTT, and battle them with your team using an action-order battle system with Normal / Strong / Agile move styles. Custom toon shaders with ink outlines give the whole world a hand-drawn look.
features: Catch 13 PIKNOTT with three kinds of PIKCEL balls
Action-order battles with Normal, Strong and Agile move styles
Sneak through tall grass while crouching to stay hidden
Team screen, CELESTIKA DOK and a region map
Rest and heal at camp fires; progress is saved automatically
Keyboard + mouse and basic gamepad support

titles.name: ファイアアウト・シャイン
titles.genre: Racing · 指名手配される GET WANTED · Open world
titles.tagline: Open-world neon Tokyo and Hikari Beach: race, escape the police and live the night as ANA and DANIEL.
titles.description: ファイアアウト・シャイン (FIREOUT SHINE) is an open-world driving game set in an original neon Tokyo and the seaside Hikari Beach. Play as ANA and DANIEL, switch between them at any time, take any car with F, enter street races and activities, and GET WANTED: outrun the police as your wanted stars climb. Customise your ride at FRGARAGE, go home to Ana and Daniel's house to sleep, save and change outfits, and use the EX IX G9 phone to call a JP Taxi. Publisher: EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL. ©2026 EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL ©2026.
features: Open-world neon Tokyo plus Hikari Beach: scramble crossing, sign-lined streets, an elevated expressway and glass skyscrapers
Play as ANA and DANIEL and switch between them at any time (Q)
Take any car with F; street races against AI rivals, a time trial, a drift zone and speed cameras
FRGARAGE: choose your car (including the DEBAUCHE sedan), paint it and set a custom number plate
Weapon wheel (Tab): fists, baseball bat, pickaxe, taser, pistol, SMG and shotgun
指名手配される GET WANTED: wanted stars (1-5) and police chases. Escape to lose them, or get BUSTED
Ana and Daniel's house: sleep, save, take a shower and change outfits in the wardrobe
EX IX G9 phone with JP Taxi and Emergency Services, map waypoints and a day/night cycle

titles.name: EX SPORTS™ SFC 27 STANDARD EDITION
titles.tagline: 7-a-side football at the SFC 27 stadium: quick matches against the AI, or online with friends using a join code.
titles.description: EX SPORTS™ SFC 27 STANDARD EDITION is 7-a-side football at the EX SPORTS SFC 27 stadium. The pitch is full size with standard markings, goals with nets, stands packed with a crowd, and floodlights. Play a QUICK MATCH against the AI, or go ONLINE: host a session, share your SFC27-XXXX-XXXX join code and play with friends, with the AI filling the empty spots. Matches are UNLIMITED by default: the clock counts up and you end the match whenever you like. Every club and player is fictional. Online play needs no admin rights and no firewall setup. Publisher: EX Inc. ©2026 EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL ©2026.
features: QUICK MATCH VS AI: pass, shoot, tackle and sprint with kickoffs, goals, a scoreboard and a match clock
ONLINE with friends via SFC27-XXXX-XXXX join codes: ALL OF US VS AI or SPLIT TEAMS, with AI fill, kick and ping
UNLIMITED matches by default (END MATCH any time), or timed 4, 8, 12 and 90 minute games
TEAMS: fictional clubs, an all-yellow kit and your own player look and name
Full-size stadium: standard pitch markings, nets, four stands with a crowd and plain floodlights
Per-user install, no admin rights; built-in update check

titles.name: THE ANULMENT
titles.tagline: Rainy night in Valdora: the vote is annulled, CLN is arrested, and MIYOYAZU sets out to find the truth.
titles.description: THE ANULMENT (Chapter 1: The Annulled Vote) is a story game set at night in the fictional country of Valdora. The Constitutional Court has annulled the first round of the presidential election and charged its winner, CLN. You play MIYOYAZU, an ordinary blogger in a grey hoodie: join the peaceful protest at the court, photograph and recover evidence, interview the prosecutors' aide and publish the truth. Take any vehicle with F, and stay calm when POLIȚIA VALDOREI pursue you. Type English with T and MIYOYAZU says it in an offline Romanian voice. All characters, parties, countries and events in this game are fictional. Publisher: EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL. ©2026 EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL ©2026.
features: Rainy night-time Valdora with wet streets and letterbox cutscenes
Peaceful protest at the Constitutional Court: placards, candles and the chant CLN PREȘEDINTE! / TURUL DOI ÎNAPOI!
Fictional police (POLIȚIA VALDOREI): shield line, questioning, a pressure meter and pursuits that box you in
Traffic with fictional brands: take any vehicle non-violently with F
T chat: type English, MIYOYAZU speaks it with the offline Romanian Piper voice (bubble + subtitles)
EX IX G10 phone: CAMERA with SELMOTES, MESSAGES, NEWS, MAP, EVIDENCE, RECORDER and SETTINGS
Evidence board, interview and the PUBLISH THE TRUTH ending; minimap, full map and save/load
Per-user install, no admin rights; built-in update check

titles.name: COKA — CALL OF KIMS ARMY
titles.tagline: Train with Ana at Camp Kim: range, kill house, night raids, and COKA ONLINE AI TRAINING.
titles.description: COKA — CALL OF KIMS ARMY is a first-person army-camp training shooter. You play Ana, a recruit of Kims Army at Camp Kim, in a dusty golden-hour camp of tents, sandbags, gabions, trucks and watchtowers. Play a 6-mission voiced campaign: basic training on the range and the obstacle course, the kill house, night ops, defending the camp against waves, a convoy escort and the final assault on the east compound. In COKA ONLINE AI TRAINING you play Team Deathmatch 6v6 or Free-for-all against named AI bots. Earn XP, rank up from Recruit to Commander, and unlock fictional weapons, attachments, digital camos and perks. All characters, units, weapons and events in this game are fictional. Publisher: EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL. ©2026 EX Inc./HYPERION DIGITAL ©2026.
features: First person with arms and weapon viewmodel, ADS sights (iron, red dot, 4x scope), bob, sway and recoil
6-mission voiced campaign with checkpoints and cinematic camera intros
COKA ONLINE AI TRAINING: TDM 6v6 and FFA 8 against named bots, 3 difficulty levels, scoreboard and match XP
Shooting range with pop-up targets, an obstacle course and a kill house
11 ranks, 5 fictional weapons, attachments, 6 digital camos and 6 perks
Golden-hour camp with real sun shadows, dust haze and smoke columns; RTX and EX HD modes, no bloom
Sprint, crouch, slide, jump, grenades, knife, hit markers, minimap and kill feed
Per-user install, no admin rights; built-in update check

titles.name: HYPERIA
titles.tagline: A creative desktop shell for Windows: wallpaper, taskbar, Start menu and windows inside the shell.
titles.description: HYPERIA is a creative desktop shell from EX Inc. that runs on Windows: wallpaper, taskbar, Start menu, desktop icons and windows that open inside the shell. It is an app, not an operating system. Web apps open the real websites in a HYPERIA web window (uses the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime).
features: Built in: HYPERIA Store, Notebook, Files, Terminal (PowerShell), Settings, Clock
Games inside the shell: Pong and Fireout 1997, an original retro top-down racer
Web windows: EX SAFARIA LITE browser and shortcuts to popular sites
F11 fullscreen; Esc closes the Start menu

titles.name: EX CREATOR STUDIO
titles.tagline: One board. Any character. Type a line and watch it talk, then download it as an MP4.
titles.description: Upload any character or art to the REX BOARD and type what it should say. EX CREATOR STUDIO speaks it with an offline Windows voice and lip-syncs the character's mouth to it, then renders the result as an MP4. REX ANIMATE turns stickman drawings into video, frame by frame, with editable titles, an audio track and MP4 export. EX ART is a layered image editor for drawings, thumbnails and screenshots, and EX STUDIO and EX SCREEN RECORDER 2026 record your screen.
features: Auto character detection for anime/cartoon faces and real faces, with mouth location
Set mouth manually by clicking or dragging a box, so any character can talk
Offline SAPI5 text-to-speech with your installed Windows voices and a speed setting
Pin screenshots onto the board, drag and resize them
Download renders an H.264/AAC MP4 to your Downloads folder
EX STUDIO screen recorder
EX ART layered image editor: brushes, selections, text, shapes, blend modes, masks, filters and 80-step undo
Add screenshots and images (drop, paste or capture), then move, resize and rotate them on their own layers
EX SCREEN RECORDER 2026: full screen, monitor, window or region to a YouTube-ready MP4 with system audio
REX ANIMATE: frame-by-frame animation with a thumbnail timeline, holds, drag reorder and 6-30 fps playback
REX ANIMATE layers, smoothing brush, lasso transform, shapes and the same colour wheel as EX ART
Editable text with outline and drop shadow that can stay on a range of frames for titles and captions
Add an MP3/WAV track with a waveform, then export MP4 (H.264 + AAC) at 1080p or 720p, GIF or PNG sequence

titles.name: EX NETWORK
titles.tagline: Keeps your WiFi connection stable: fewer drop-outs, auto-reconnect and one-click repairs.
titles.description: A small Windows app that helps keep your WiFi connection stable. It does not make your internet faster; it cuts down on drop-outs and lag spikes caused by Windows power saving, reconnects automatically when the link dies, and gives you one-click versions of the usual network repair commands.
features: Live status: SSID, signal, receive/transmit rate, band and channel
Stabilize: turns off WiFi adapter power saving (restores your settings when turned off)
Auto-reconnect watchdog after 3 failed pings
Repair: flush DNS, release/renew, optional Winsock reset
Ping test with average/min/max latency and packet loss

titles.name: EX SUDO TERMINAL
titles.tagline: A GUI terminal for PowerShell with a persistent ConPTY session and one-click Run as admin.
titles.description: EX SUDO TERMINAL is a Windows GUI terminal for PowerShell. It runs a persistent ConPTY PowerShell session (so cd and variables stick), streams output live, and can relaunch itself as administrator when you need elevated rights.
features: Persistent ConPTY PowerShell session; interactive tools run inside the window
Monospace output and an input line with history (Up/Down), Enter to run, Ctrl+C to stop
Run as admin relaunches the app elevated
One-click Install Grok CLI button (runs only when you click it)

titles.name: FIREOUT REVOLUTION™
titles.tagline: Live viewer for FIREOUT REVOLUTION Slides.pdf from your Downloads folder.
titles.description: FIREOUT REVOLUTION™ is a live viewer for FIREOUT REVOLUTION Slides.pdf in your Downloads folder. It fits each slide to the window and refreshes live when the PDF changes.
features: Fit-to-window slide view
Live refresh when the PDF changes
Left/Right arrow keys change slides
Built-in update check

titles.name: 簡単に日本語を学ぶ — learn japanese easy
titles.tagline: A Book of True Value. Discover the hidden gems of life through the eyes of EX. 簡単に日本語を学ぶ
titles.description: An ebook by EX Inc. for learning beginner Japanese. Turn its pages with a smooth page-turn, swipe or the arrow keys. It covers hiragana and katakana charts, a gojūon page and 24 beginner kanji with readings, and 40 everyday words (greetings, numbers 1–10, food, family). Each word comes with furigana, an orange kana line, romaji and English. There are also three quizzes. Tap a word or a character to hear it. Make your own pages in the Page Maker: type English to get the Japanese with automatic furigana and romaji (offline), paint on them with an ink brush, keep them under My Pages, or export them as PNG or PDF.
features: Page-turn reader: arrows, keys, swipe-drag, contents, bookmarks and zoom
Kana and beginner kanji reference pages in a grey vertical style, plus hiragana and katakana charts
40 words with furigana, romaji and English, plus 3 tap-to-answer quizzes
Built-in Japanese audio. Tap any word or character (offline)
Page Maker: offline English → 日本語, auto furigana and romaji, ink brush with colour wheel, eraser and undo
Save to My Pages. Export PNG or PDF
Per-user install, no admin
